stories.headline: Magical Creatures Desk Submits Formal Nomination to 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' Registry; Candidate: One Household Dog, Offence Unknown, Warmth Indisputable
stories.byline: By our Ministry correspondent, who has also reviewed the file and agrees it belongs there
body: The Ministry of Magic's Magical Creatures Desk submitted the first formal nomination for a second entry to the 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' registry late Monday afternoon, filing a case described internally as 'persistent, undeniable, and frankly a little difficult to write up without smiling.' The candidate: one Jersey, male, household familiar, occupation Lap Occupancy (Professional Grade).

The Desk had apparently been sitting on a file since late July, when a routine Domestic Familiar Wellness Survey logged Jersey's daily routine and found it technically in violation of seven productivity guidelines — each of which he had apparently neutralised by sitting on the relevant Ministry assessor for between twenty and forty minutes. 'He didn't resist,' wrote the assessor in her notes. 'He just got comfortable. I also got comfortable. This is, I believe, the mechanism.' The file was flagged, then quietly set aside, then retrieved Monday when the new registry opened a slot.

Senior Archivist Quoyne received the nomination at quarter to five and read it in full. He has not yet ruled. He has, however, cleared the space on the shelf that would be required for a second divider.

stories.headline: Tuesday's Difficult Account Resolved by Ten-Fifteen; Goblin Senior Council Thanks Christine by Briefly Making Eye Contact
body: A longstanding dispute between the Gringotts Sub-Treasury and one Mr. Aldous Fitch — eleven months, four formal hearings, and two separate interventions by the Goblin Liaison Office — was resolved this morning in forty minutes by Senior Client Liaison Christine, who required only a certified ledger, a sharpened quill, and the specific expression she reserves for situations that should have been simple.

The Goblin Senior Council, which does not typically acknowledge human staff by any perceptible gesture, is reported by three independent witnesses to have briefly looked directly at her as she left the chamber. One goblin is said to have nodded. The matter has been referred to the Gringotts Chaplaincy for confirmation.

stories.headline: Biscuit Tin Moved From Counter to High Shelf; No Evidence Gathered; Investigation Ongoing; Lucy Unavailable for Comment
body: The household biscuit tin, previously occupying a fixed position on the kitchen counter for a period of not less than three years, was discovered Tuesday morning to have been moved to the high shelf above the kettle. The tin remains sealed. No pawprints were recovered. Lucy was in the sitting room when questioned, which, the Investigation Desk notes, is exactly where someone who had already finished would be.

Ellie, asked for her account of the evening, described seeing 'a very fast blur that smelled like Tuesday,' and added that she had said hello to the blur but it had not said hello back, which she found rude. Jersey was on the sofa throughout and is not a suspect, though he is noted to have been facing away from the kitchen, which the Desk considers a statistically interesting choice.

stories.headline: Tuesday Conditions Filed; Gorge Reports Fog in 'Confident Autumnal Form'; Ridgeline Now Has a Reputation and Is Aware of It
body: The Red River Gorge has filed its Tuesday morning conditions report, describing fog distribution as 'confident, seasonal, and performing well for this time of year.' The hollows are holding at a comfortable ambient mystery. The ridgeline, following recent events, has been noted by the Survey Office to carry itself with what a senior naturalist described as 'a faint but measurable sense of occasion.'

Steve and the Jeep completed a brief Tuesday reconnaissance — conditions assessed, mud acceptable, the enchanted Jeep registering no complaint beyond a mild vibration on the descent that Steve has diagnosed as character. The Jeep, reached for comment, indicated it was fine, actually.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Is enjoying the biscuit tin's new location enormously, which she describes as 'more natural,' and has no further thoughts on the matter at this time.

Ellie: Spent a productive Tuesday morning introducing herself to the kettle, which she found friendly, and to the refrigerator, which she found cold and unresponsive but has chosen to give a second chance.
Jersey: Occupied the armchair from half-past seven until noon, at which point he relocated to the ottoman for the afternoon session. The transition was seamless. He is very well.
founding_editor_note: That high shelf was built with a sixteen-inch stud spacing and a double-anchored bracket, so the biscuit tin is perfectly safe up there — I am simply noting that whoever moved it should probably have planned the return trip more carefully. — D.

in_brief.sport: The Gringotts Interdepartmental Lifting Record remains uncontested; the current record-holder has not been in to defend it, presumably because she had better things to do before lunch.
in_brief.forecast: Fog persisting through midweek with intermittent certainty; biscuits overcast but structurally sound; Tuesday evening expected to proceed without drama, pending further investigation.

storyline_updates.title: The New Registry
storyline_updates.summary: Day 2: The Magical Creatures Desk has formally nominated Jersey for the second entry in the 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' registry, citing his July encounter with a Ministry assessor and the mechanism by which he resolves all disputes (getting comfortable, then making others comfortable). Quoyne has received the nomination and cleared the shelf space for a second divider. He has not yet ruled. Day 3 should develop Quoyne's deliberation — perhaps another department files a competing nomination, or Quoyne conducts a quiet inquiry that involves visiting the household or requesting a character reference from an unexpected party (the assessor? the goblins? the ridgeline survey office?). Build warmly toward a Day 4 resolution in which the registry receives its second entry with suitable ceremony.
